draftContext.markdown:
Tuesday's original generation stopped action review before either action agent ran: the required #357 discussion exceeded the 128 KiB source cap. Its original proposed suggestions were not retained and remain unknown. The three follow-ups in this article are new supervised curation from source-checked existing checkpoints; they do not recover that lost output.

The shortlist continues Monday's timing, recovery and timestamp work with the original identities and decision gates. No action was admitted, executed or settled in this revision. The later scheduled run skipped generation because the article already existed. Mac dispatcher implementation and activation remain deferred, and hosted evidence retention remains blocked.
